title: Circuit acceptance probability
statement: For a circuit $C$ on $n$ Boolean inputs and a probability mass function $\mu$ on Boolean assignments to those inputs, its acceptance probability is the sum, over all assignments $x$, of $\mu(x)$ for those assignments on which $C$ evaluates to true.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is a probability mass function on assignments to the $n$ inputs
